purpose: Render evidence in a short teacher-readable format while preserving source type, jurisdiction and locator precision.

CN_curriculum.zh: 教育部《义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）》 · {printed_range} · {stage} · {section}

PEP_revised_detail.zh: 人教版修订教材配套资料 · {grade}年级{semester} · {unit} · {detail}

Common_Core.zh: 美国 Common Core 基线 · Grade {grade} · {standard_codes}

display_rules: Show source type before source details when curriculum, guidance and research appear together.
Use the shortest locator that uniquely supports the visible claim.
For China 2022, a verified printed domain range plus stage/section is acceptable when an exact single bullet page has not been directly rendered; never fabricate the single page.
For revised PEP, exact grade/semester/unit may be shown from the authoritative all-volume sequence.
Do not append a subsection, textbook page or teacher-guide page unless that finer locator is separately registered.
PEP series sequence does not establish locality-specific current use; rollout qualification is separate.
If Common Core has no Grade 1-6 requirement for the concept, display No explicit Common Core Grade 1-6 standard rather than an empty citation.
Do not cite an umbrella source when a specific practice guide or guidance page directly supports the claim.
The Evidence section should normally show 2-4 sources, not every source attached to the concept.
